description: ODC (context: Mobile app). A CrossDevice app refuses what only a Mobile app has: 'On Sync objects can't be children of App objects', 'MobileConfigurations objects can't be children of App objects', 'On Sync Start objects can't be children of Screen objects'. On the blank Mobile app (create-blank --kind Mobile) the same types are born: the module OnSync, the Mobile Configurations and the three sync events of the screen. The screen events are fixed places (<screen>.#OnSyncStart): every Mobile screen is already born with them, a second one is refused ('An item with the same key has already been added') and what you do is link them to a screen action, or delete and create again. Extensibility Setting is also born here (in a CrossDevice app: 'can't be created in Reactive runtime kind').

expectedMessages.why: the minimal UI flow has no OnException; the job proves the sync events, not exception handling
the OnSync is born with the input Context; the minimal flow does not read it
the setting exists to prove that it is born in a Mobile app; nobody reads it

ops.name: CovMScreen
ops._why: a screen before the OnSync: without screens the OnSync warns ClientSystemAction_NotExecutable
the event the screen already has now calls the screen action
the empty place accepts a new event: the create is only refused when the place is occupied
